issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Topview Motion Studio
products.tagline: Create launch videos without touching After Effects
products.summaryZh: 无需接触After Effects，即可制作发布视频。
products.descriptionZh: Motion Studio帮助团队为应用、硬件和新产品制作精美的发布视频，无需学习After Effects，也无需聘请动态设计工作室。只需描述你想传达的内容，上传参考图片，并选择视觉风格、时长和宽高比。Motion Studio将AI视频模型与专为动态设计打造的能力相结合，将你的简报转化为高质量的产品叙事——更快、更简单，成本仅为传统方式的一小部分。
products.description: Motion Studio helps teams create polished launch videos for apps, hardware, and new products without learning After Effects or hiring a motion design studio. Describe what you want to communicate, upload reference images, and choose a visual style, duration, and aspect ratio. Motion Studio combines AI video models with purpose-built motion design skills to turn your brief into high-quality product storytelling—faster, simpler, and at a fraction of the traditional cost.

products.name: Hyperfocus
products.tagline: Planner that turns goals into daily progress
products.summaryZh: 将目标转化为每日进度的规划工具
products.descriptionZh: Hyperfocus 是一款面向 macOS 的免费、目标优先规划工具。它帮助您挑选出最重要的少数成果，围绕它们规划每周与每日安排，并通过专注工作实现持续进步。
products.description: Hyperfocus is a free, goals-first planner for macOS. It helps you choose the few outcomes that matter most, plan weeks and days around them, and make consistent progress by doing focused work

products.name: Olostep
products.tagline: Turn the Web into Clean Data for AI
products.summaryZh: 将网络转化为适用于AI的干净数据
products.descriptionZh: Olostep提供可扩展的网页数据API，专为互联网的第二用户——AI而设计。轻松将任何URL转换为适用于LLM的Markdown、JSON或结构化数据，并利用该API进行代理式搜索工作流。
products.description: Olostep provides scalable web data APIs, specifically designed for the web’s second user - AI. Effortlessly turn any URL into LLM-ready Markdown, JSON, or structured data and use the API for agentic search workflows

products.name: Prequel
products.tagline: Create cinematic screen recordings on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上制作电影级屏幕录制。
products.descriptionZh: 一款macOS屏幕录制工具，直接输出成品视频。支持跟随操作的缩放、带边框的摄像头画面及背景，可在Mac自带的媒体引擎上以最高4K分辨率导出。
products.description: A macOS screen recorder that hands back a finished video. Zooms that follow the work, a framed camera and a background, exported at up to 4K on your Mac's own media engine.

products.name: Murfy AI
products.tagline: Write, review, and publish to arXiv 10x faster
products.summaryZh: 撰写、审阅并发布至arXiv，速度提升10倍
products.descriptionZh: Murfy是一支覆盖整个研究写作流程的AI代理团队。Murfy帮助你在上下文中撰写和审阅论文，即时修复LaTeX编译错误，验证参考文献，并在几分钟内生成Beamer幻灯片。支持无限协作者、实时编辑，免费开始使用。
products.description: Murfy is a team of AI agents for the entire research writing workflow. Murfy helps to write and review your paper in context, fix LaTeX compile errors on the spot, verify reference papers and generate Beamer slides in minutes. Work with unlimited collaborators, real-time editing, free to start.

products.name: Referent
products.tagline: The AI-native OS for modern law firms
products.summaryZh: 面向现代律所的AI原生操作系统
products.descriptionZh: Referent是一款AI原生的法律实务管理软件。法律AI代理处理运营工作，让律师专注于客户与业务增长。
products.description: Referent is AI-native legal practice management software. Legal AI agents handle the operational work while lawyers focus on clients and growth.

products.name: Ravioli
products.tagline: Create custom stamp shapes
products.summaryZh: 创建自定义印章形状
products.descriptionZh: Ravioli是一款微型设计工具，用于创建自定义邮票形状。选择形状，调整邮票尺寸、孔洞和圆角，然后将结果导出为透明PNG或可缩放SVG。
products.description: Ravioli is a tiny design tool for creating custom postage-stamp shapes. Select a shape, adjust the stamp size, holes and roundness, then export your result as a transparent PNG or scalable SVG.

products.name: RIP MY BUILD
products.tagline: Give your abandoned side project one last launch
products.summaryZh: 给你被搁置的副项目最后一次发布机会
products.descriptionZh: RIP MY BUILD 是一个副业项目墓地，用于诚实的公开复盘。发布永久讣告，附上原始链接、死因、经验教训，以及你接下来正在构建的内容。每份纪念都会获得一个可分享的页面、访客献花、永久墓位装饰，以及每周荣誉排行榜。它将项目结束时有用的真相转化为一种了结、一份发布资产，以及通往创始人下一章的路径。每份讣告12美元；浏览无需账户。
products.description: RIP MY BUILD is a side project cemetery for honest public postmortems. Publish a permanent obituary with the original link, cause of death, lesson learned, and whatever you’re building next. Every memorial gets a shareable page, visitor roses, permanent plot adornments, and a weekly honors leaderboard. It turns the useful truth at the end of a project into closure, a launch asset, and a path to the founder’s next chapter. $12 per obituary; no account needed to browse.

products.name: Ulpaso
products.tagline: Stop paying just to take meeting notes
products.summaryZh: 别再为会议记录付费了。
products.descriptionZh: 你的会议笔记应用想要录音、账户和信用卡。Ulpaso不需要。按下录音键。麦克风加系统音频在你的Mac上转写，生成一个你真正能编辑的Markdown文件。无云端，无登录，无需每月20美元买个清单。
products.description: Your meeting-notes app wants the recording, an account, and a card. Ulpaso doesn't. Press record. Mic + system audio get transcribed on your Mac and land in a Markdown file you can actually edit. No cloud. No login. No $20/mo for a checklist.

products.name: Superagent
products.tagline: Claude Code for the rest of us
products.summaryZh: Claude Code，为其余的人而作
products.descriptionZh: 与编码代理协作，应如同使用一款优秀的Mac应用，而非终端。Superagent赋予你的代理一台电脑：一个驱动你已登录会话的真实浏览器，一个可点击滑动的iOS模拟器，你的文件，一个它维护的看板，以及定时执行的任务。聊天记录置于侧边栏，可分组，重启后依然保留，从不打扰你的专注。每个会话运行在独立的git工作树中。配对iPhone后，工作随行，端到端加密。无需账户，无需服务器，无额外账单。开源。
products.description: Working with a coding agent should feel like using a good Mac app, not a terminal. Superagent gives yours a computer: a real browser it drives on your own logged-in sessions, an iOS Simulator it taps and swipes, your files, a board it keeps, routines on a timer. Chats sit in a sidebar you can group, survive restarts, and never steal your focus. Each runs on its own git worktree. Pair your iPhone and the work follows you, encrypted end to end. No account, no server, no second bill. Open source.

products.name: Maritime
products.tagline: Dedicated computers for AI agents, starting at $1/month
products.summaryZh: 专为AI代理设计的专用计算机，每月仅需1美元起
products.descriptionZh: Maritime帮助销售AI代理的公司为每位客户提供拥有独立计算机的代理。每个代理在隔离、持久的虚拟机中运行，可使用浏览器、创建文件、运行代码并保持其状态。Maritime负责基础设施、扩展和自动休眠/唤醒，因此您无需自行构建和管理数千台虚拟机。专为大规模运行代理的公司设计，起价每个代理每月1美元。
products.description: Maritime helps companies that sell AI agents give every customer an agent with its own computer. Each agent runs in an isolated, persistent VM where it can use a browser, create files, run code, and keep its state. Maritime handles the infrastructure, scaling, and automatic sleep/wake, so you don’t have to build and manage thousands of VMs yourself. Built for companies running agents at scale, starting at $1 per agent per month.

products.name: Sayscroll
products.tagline: The AI Teleprompter that scrolls as you speak
products.summaryZh: AI提词器，随言而滚
products.descriptionZh: SAYSCROLL是一款AI提词器，能跟随你的声音，让你自然演讲，无需频繁调整滚动速度。它支持60多种语言，适用于视频、演示、演讲及直播内容。 - 内置录像功能——阅读脚本时同步录制自己 - 即兴发挥——当你脱离脚本时，提词器会暂停等待 - 基于浏览器——无需下载或安装 - 专业级控制——文本大小、列宽、对齐方式，以及专业屏幕的镜像控制
products.description: SAYSCROLL is an AI teleprompter that follows your voice, so you can speak naturally instead of constantly adjusting your scroll speed. It supports 60+ languages and works across videos, demos, presentations, and live content. - Built-in video recorder —Record yourself while reading your script - Improvise —The prompter waits while you go off script - Browser based —No downloads or setup - Studio-ready controls —Text size, column width, alignment, +mirror controls for pro screens

products.name: Retro Y2K Theme
products.tagline: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme
products.summaryZh: 为任意网站定制复古90年代与Y2K风格主题
products.descriptionZh: 为任意网站添加90年代与Y2K复古主题。享受怀旧网页美学与经典UI设计！重返2000年从未如此简单！RawY2K是一款终极复古网站修改工具，可将任何现代网页瞬间转变为90年代与Y2K风格的怀旧体验。通过自定义光标、怀旧Windows 98界面及经典GeoCities风格主题，即刻定制你的浏览器。重温互联网的黄金时代——那个网页原始、有趣且充满混乱创意的年代。
products.description: Customize any website with a vintage 90s & Y2K retro theme. Enjoy nostalgic web aesthetics, and classic UI designs! Back to 2000 has never been easier! RawY2K is the ultimate retro website modifier that transforms any modern web page into a vintage 90s and Y2K aesthetic experience. Customize your browser with custom cursors, nostalgic Windows 98 UI, and classic GeoCities style themes instantly. Relive the golden age of the internet where the web was raw, fun, and full of chaotic creativity.

products.name: oMLX
products.tagline: Mac LLM server that cuts agent wait times from 90s to 5s
products.summaryZh: Mac LLM服务器，将代理等待时间从90秒缩短至5秒
products.descriptionZh: oMLX将你的Mac变成完整的LLM推理服务器，可从菜单栏运行。它提供文本、视觉、OCR、嵌入和重排序模型，支持连续批处理，并配备RAM+SSD分层KV缓存，重启后依然保留，使Claude Code和Cursor的响应时间从约90秒缩短至约5秒。兼容OpenAI和Anthropic的API可直接接入。原生Swift编写，非Electron。Apache 2.0开源许可。
products.description: oMLX turns your Mac into a full LLM inference server, run from the menu bar. It serves text, vision, OCR, embedding and reranker models with continuous batching, plus a RAM+SSD tiered KV cache that survives restarts, so Claude Code and Cursor respond in about 5s instead of 90s. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible APIs drop straight in. Native Swift, not Electron. Apache 2.0, open source.

products.name: Edge Drop
products.tagline: Clipboard on your screen edge. Hover to open, drag to drop
products.summaryZh: 屏幕边缘的剪贴板。悬停打开，拖拽放置。
products.descriptionZh: Win+V让你停下工作，而Edge-Drop不会。它驻留在Windows屏幕边缘——平时隐形，悬停即现。随后剪贴板架弹出，复制文本、截图、文件或链接，直接拖入任意应用。堆叠文件、固定常用项，保持工作流不断。无需快捷键，无托盘图标，无需账户。历史记录绝不离开你的电脑。免费开源，支持Windows 10和11。可通过GitHub或Microsoft Store获取。
products.description: Win+V makes you stop working. Edge-Drop doesn't. It lives on the edge of your Windows screen - invisible until you hover. Then a clipboard shelf springs open. Copy text, screenshots, files, or links and drag them straight into any app. Stack files, pin keepers, stay in flow. No shortcuts, no tray, no account. History never leaves your PC. Free and open source. Windows 10 and 11. GitHub or Microsoft Store.

products.name: Skud
products.tagline: Menubar file delivery with your brand and tracking
products.summaryZh: 菜单栏文件传输，支持您的品牌与追踪功能
products.descriptionZh: Skud 常驻你的 Mac 菜单栏。拖入任意文件 → 上传，生成品牌链接，并追踪谁打开了它。自定义品牌（标志、颜色、封面图片），密码保护，过期控制。1 GB 以内免费传输。专为追求自主权的设计师和工作室打造。
products.description: Skud lives in your Mac menubar. Drop any file → uploads, copies a branded link, tracks who opens it. Custom brand (logo, colour, cover image), password protection, expiration control. Free for 1 GB deliveries. Built for designers and studios who want ownership.

products.name: Caplio
products.tagline: Find, organize, and reuse every image on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上查找、整理并复用所有图片。
products.descriptionZh: Caplio将零散的截图和图片整理成Mac上一个私密、可搜索的资料库。它相当于一个轻量级的截图与日常图片资产管理工具。添加文件夹后，Caplio会自动监控、索引，并通过设备端OCR提取文字。你可以按时间线、搜索或分类浏览；文件自动整理，之后可将任意图片直接拖入其他应用。无需上传或云端OCR，你的图片始终保留在Mac上。
products.description: Caplio turns scattered screenshots and images into a private, searchable library on your Mac. Think of it as a lightweight asset manager for screenshots and everyday images. Add your folders, and Caplio automatically watches, indexes, and extracts text with on-device OCR. Browse by timeline, search, or category; organize files automatically, then drag any image straight into another app. No uploads or cloud OCR. Your images stay on your Mac.

products.name: Softorino Online Converter
products.tagline: Free & Safe online file converter. No ads. No bs.
products.summaryZh: 免费且安全的在线文件转换器。无广告，无废话。
products.descriptionZh: 隐私优先是核心。所有操作均在您的设备上完成，文件不会上传至任何地方。直接在浏览器中转换视频、音乐、语音备忘录和GIF——无需注册，无广告，无水印，无限制。支持MP4、MOV、MKV、WebM、AVI、MP3、WAV、FLAC、AAC、OGG、M4A等多种格式。永久免费，由WALTR团队打造。
products.description: Privacy first is the core. Everything happens on your device, so your files never get uploaded anywhere. Convert video, music, voice memos & GIFs right in your browser – no sign-up, no ads, no watermarks, no limits. Handles MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A & more. Free forever, from the team behind WALTR.

products.name: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash
products.tagline: Controllable AI Video Generation for Developers
products.summaryZh: 面向开发者的可控AI视频生成
products.descriptionZh: 将AI视频提示词转化为可投入生产的素材。Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash为开发者提供对场景扩展、关键帧过渡及快速草稿渲染的精细控制，可通过Google AI Studio和Gemini企业代理平台实现。立即在blog.google上开始使用Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash进行开发。
products.description: Turn AI video prompts into production-ready footage. Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash gives developers fine-grained control over scene extension, keyframe transitions, and rapid draft rendering via Google AI Studio and the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Start building with Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash today at blog.google!

products.name: Cord
products.tagline: From proposal to payment. All in a single link.
products.summaryZh: 从提案到付款，一切尽在一个链接中。
products.descriptionZh: Cord将您的整个商业周期集中在一个互动体验中：智能利润提案、具有法律约束力的审批、自动收款和开票——您的客户无需下载任何内容或创建账户。
products.description: Cord centralizes your entire commercial cycle in one interactive experience: margin-intelligent proposals, legally binding approval, automated collections, and invoicing — your client never downloads anything or creates an account.
